arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
transliteration: Wat-Toor

translations.en.sahih: By the mount
translations.en.pickthall: By the Mount,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Mount (of Revelation);
translations.id.indonesian: Demi bukit,

arabic: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
transliteration: Wa kitaabim mastoor

translations.en.sahih: And [by] a Book inscribed
translations.en.pickthall: And a Scripture inscribed
translations.en.yusufali: By a Decree inscribed
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kitab yang ditulis,

arabic: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
transliteration: Fee raqqim manshoor

translations.en.sahih: In parchment spread open
translations.en.pickthall: On fine parchment unrolled,
translations.en.yusufali: In a Scroll unfolded;
translations.id.indonesian: pada lembaran yang terbuka,

arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
transliteration: Wal baitil ma'moor

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the frequented House
translations.en.pickthall: And the House frequented,
translations.en.yusufali: By the much-frequented Fane;
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi Baitul Ma'mur,

arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
transliteration: Wassaqfil marfoo'

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the heaven raised high
translations.en.pickthall: And the roof exalted,
translations.en.yusufali: By the Canopy Raised High;
translations.id.indonesian: dan atap yang ditinggikan (langit),

arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
transliteration: Wal bahril masjoor

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
translations.en.pickthall: And the sea kept filled,
translations.en.yusufali: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan laut yang di dalam tanahnya ada api,

arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
transliteration: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi'

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya azab Tuhanmu pasti terjadi,

arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
transliteration: Maa lahoo min daafi'

translations.en.sahih: Of it there is no preventer.
translations.en.pickthall: There is none that can ward it off.
translations.en.yusufali: There is none can avert it;-
translations.id.indonesian: tidak seorangpun yang dapat menolaknya,

arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
transliteration: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
translations.en.yusufali: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
translations.id.indonesian: pada hari ketika langit benar-benar bergoncang,

arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
transliteration: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
translations.en.pickthall: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
translations.en.yusufali: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
translations.id.indonesian: dan gunung benar-benar berjalan.

arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
transliteration: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen

translations.en.sahih: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
translations.en.pickthall: Then woe that day unto the deniers
translations.en.yusufali: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kecelakaan yang besarlah di hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan,

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
transliteration: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon

translations.en.sahih: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
translations.en.pickthall: Who play in talk of grave matters;
translations.en.yusufali: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) orang-orang yang bermain-main dalam kebathilan,

arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
transliteration: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa

translations.en.sahih: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
translations.en.pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
translations.en.yusufali: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
translations.id.indonesian: pada hari mereka didorong ke neraka Jahannam dengan sekuat-kuatnya.

arabic: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
transliteration: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

translations.en.sahih: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
translations.en.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
translations.en.yusufali: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Inilah neraka yang dahulu kamu selalu mendustakannya".

arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
transliteration: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon

translations.en.sahih: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
translations.en.pickthall: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
translations.en.yusufali: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah ini sihir? Ataukah kamu tidak melihat?

arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
translations.en.pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
translations.en.yusufali: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
translations.id.indonesian: Masukklah kamu ke dalamnya (rasakanlah panas apinya); maka baik kamu bersabar atau tidak, sama saja bagimu; kamu diberi balasan terhadap apa yang telah kamu kerjakan.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
translations.en.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa berada dalam surga dan kenikmatan,

arabic: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
transliteration: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem

translations.en.sahih: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.en.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
translations.en.yusufali: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka bersuka ria dengan apa yang diberikan kepada mereka oleh Tuhan mereka; dan Tuhan mereka memelihara mereka dari azab neraka.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
transliteration: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
translations.en.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
translations.en.yusufali: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
translations.id.indonesian: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Makan dan minumlah dengan enak sebagai balasan dari apa yang telah kamu kerjakan",

arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
transliteration: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een

translations.en.sahih: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
translations.en.pickthall: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
translations.en.yusufali: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
translations.id.indonesian: mereka bertelekan di atas dipan-dipan berderetan dan Kami kawinkan mereka dengan bidadari-bidadari yang cantik bermata jeli.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
transliteration: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

translations.en.sahih: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
translations.en.pickthall: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
translations.en.yusufali: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-oranng yang beriman, dan yang anak cucu mereka mengikuti mereka dalam keimanan, Kami hubungkan anak cucu mereka dengan mereka, dan Kami tiada mengurangi sedikitpun dari pahala amal mereka. Tiap-tiap manusia terikat dengan apa yang dikerjakannya.

arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
transliteration: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon

translations.en.sahih: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
translations.en.pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
translations.en.yusufali: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami beri mereka tambahan dengan buah-buahan dan daging dari segala jenis yang mereka ingini.

arabic: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
transliteration: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem

translations.en.sahih: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
translations.en.pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
translations.en.yusufali: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalam surga mereka saling memperebutkan piala (gelas) yang isinya tidak (menimbulkan) kata-kata yang tidak berfaedah dan tiada pula perbuatan dosa.

arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
transliteration: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon

translations.en.sahih: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
translations.en.pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
translations.en.yusufali: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berkeliling di sekitar mereka anak-anak muda untuk (melayani) mereka, seakan-akan mereka itu mutiara yang tersimpan.

arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
transliteration: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon

translations.en.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
translations.en.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
translations.en.yusufali: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sebahagian mereka menghadap kepada sebahagian yang lain saling tanya-menanya.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
transliteration: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
translations.en.pickthall: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
translations.en.yusufali: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami dahulu, sewaktu berada di tengah-tengah keluarga kami merasa takut (akan diazab)".

arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
transliteration: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom

translations.en.sahih: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
translations.en.pickthall: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
translations.en.yusufali: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka Allah memberikan karunia kepada kami dan memelihara kami dari azab neraka.

arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
transliteration: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
translations.en.yusufali: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kami dahulu menyembah-Nya. Sesungguhnya Dialah yang melimpahkan kebaikan lagi Maha Penyayang.

arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
transliteration: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon

translations.en.sahih: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka tetaplah memberi peringatan, dan kamu disebabkan nikmat Tuhanmu bukanlah seorang tukang tenung dan bukan pula seorang gila.

arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
translations.en.pickthall: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
translations.id.indonesian: Bahkan mereka mengatakan: "Dia adalah seorang penyair yang kami tunggu-tunggu kecelakaan menimpanya".

arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
translations.en.pickthall: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
translations.en.yusufali: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
translations.id.indonesian: Katakanlah: "Tunggulah, maka sesungguhnya akupun termasuk orang yang menunggu (pula) bersama kamu".

arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
transliteration: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

translations.en.sahih: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
translations.en.pickthall: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
translations.en.yusufali: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka diperintah oleh fikiran-fikiran mereka untuk mengucapkan tuduhan-tuduhan ini ataukah mereka kaum yang melampaui batas?

arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
translations.en.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah mereka mengatakan: "Dia (Muhammad) membuat-buatnya". Sebenarnya mereka tidak beriman.

arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
translations.en.pickthall: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
translations.en.yusufali: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
translations.id.indonesian: Maka hendaklah mereka mendatangkan kalimat yang semisal Al Quran itu jika mereka orang-orang yang benar.

arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon

translations.en.sahih: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
translations.en.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
translations.en.yusufali: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah mereka diciptakan tanpa sesuatupun ataukah mereka yang menciptakan (diri mereka sendiri)?

arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
transliteration: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon

translations.en.sahih: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
translations.en.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
translations.en.yusufali: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah mereka telah menciptakan langit dan bumi itu?; sebenarnya mereka tidak meyakini (apa yang mereka katakan).

arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
transliteration: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon

translations.en.sahih: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
translations.en.pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
translations.en.yusufali: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah di sisi mereka ada perbendaharaan Tuhanmu atau merekakah yang berkuasa?

arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
transliteration: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen

translations.en.sahih: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
translations.en.pickthall: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah mereka mempunyai tangga (ke langit) untuk mendengarkan pada tangga itu (hal-hal yang gaib)? Maka hendaklah orang yang mendengarkan di antara mereka mendatangkan suatu keterangan yang nyata.

arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
transliteration: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon

translations.en.sahih: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
translations.en.pickthall: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
translations.en.yusufali: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah untuk Allah anak-anak perempuan dan untuk kamu anak-anak laki-laki?

arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
transliteration: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

translations.en.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
translations.en.pickthall: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
translations.en.yusufali: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah kamu meminta upah kepada mereka sehingga mereka dibebani dengan hutang?

arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
transliteration: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon

translations.en.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
translations.en.pickthall: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
translations.en.yusufali: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah ada pada sisi mereka pengetahuan tentang yang gaib lalu mereka menuliskannya?

arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
transliteration: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon

translations.en.sahih: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
translations.en.pickthall: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
translations.en.yusufali: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah mereka hendak melakukan tipu daya? Maka orang-orang yang kafir itu merekalah yang kena tipu daya.

arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
transliteration: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon

translations.en.sahih: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
translations.en.pickthall: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah mereka mempunyai tuhan selain Allah. Maha Suci Allah dari apa yang mereka persekutukan.

arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
transliteration: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

translations.en.sahih: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
translations.en.pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
translations.en.yusufali: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
translations.id.indonesian: Jika mereka melihat sebagian dari langit gugur, mereka akan mengatakan: "Itu adalah awan yang bertindih-tindih".

arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
transliteration: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon

translations.en.sahih: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
translations.en.pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
translations.en.yusufali: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka biarkanlah mereka hingga mereka menemui hari (yang dijanjikan kepada) mereka yang pada hari itu mereka dibinasakan,

arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
transliteration: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

translations.en.sahih: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
translations.en.pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
translations.en.yusufali: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) hari ketika tidak berguna bagi mereka sedikitpun tipu daya mereka dan mereka tidak ditolong.

arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
translations.en.pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
translations.en.yusufali: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya untuk orang-orang yang zalim ada azab selain daripada itu. Tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak mengetahui.

arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
transliteration: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom

translations.en.sahih: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
translations.en.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
translations.en.yusufali: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bersabarlah dalam menunggu ketetapan Tuhanmu, maka sesungguhnya kamu berada dalam penglihatan Kami, dan bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu ketika kamu bangun berdiri,

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
transliteration: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom

translations.en.sahih: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
translations.en.pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
translations.en.yusufali: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
translations.id.indonesian: dan bertasbihlah kepada-Nya pada beberapa saat di malam hari dan di waktu terbenam bintang-bintang (di waktu fajar).
